# telnyx_portout_status_update (Action)

Authorizes or rejects a port-out request: set `status` to `authorized` or `rejected-pending`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Reject a port-out request. Needs Terraform 1.14 or later:
#   terraform apply -invoke=action.telnyx_portout_status_update.reject
action "telnyx_portout_status_update" "reject" {
  config {
    id     = var.portout_id
    status = "rejected-pending"
    reason = "The account PIN does not match."
  }
}

variable "portout_id" {
  type = string
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The object's id.
- `reason` (String) Provide a reason if rejecting the port out request
- `status` (String) The status id.

### Optional

- `host_messaging` (Boolean) Indicates whether messaging services should be maintained with Telnyx after the port out completes
